Hero.title: Cognitive Development Reimagined
Hero.subtitle: Pedagogical brain-training games designed for children aged 6-10 to boost logic, memory, and spatial reasoning skills.

Features.title: Empower Your Child's Brain
Features.subtitle: Discover the 4 key pedagogical pillars designed to stretch and grow young minds.
Features.f1_desc: Engaging visual puzzles, grid memory tasks, and number sequences.
Features.f2_desc: No servers, no tracking, completely safe for children to play anywhere.
Features.f3_desc: Adaptive focus engine dynamically scales difficulty to match their learning speed.
Features.f4_desc: Track progress graphs and print custom worksheets from weaker topics.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Trust
Privacy.intro: CogniStar is built to be a safe, offline, and zero-tracking environment. We do not store or transmit any child data to external servers.
Privacy.coppa_desc: We comply fully with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act. No names, email addresses, or coordinates are gathered from kids.
Privacy.storage_desc: All stars, badges, and performance indicators are stored locally using encrypted on-device storage.

Support.title: Support Center
Support.subtitle: Have questions or need assistance? We are here to help.
Support.faq_q1: How does the adaptive difficulty system work?
Support.faq_a1: Our pedagogical focus engine checks correct and incorrect responses at each stage, adjusting subsequent question parameters to keep the child challenged but not frustrated.
Support.faq_a2: No, CogniStar is completely ad-free to ensure children can focus without distraction.
Support.faq_q3: Can my child print worksheets on a phone?
Support.faq_a3: Yes! The worksheet generator formats custom A4 PDF pages directly from the device which can be printed wirelessly or shared.

MMR.title: The Cognitive ELO & MMR System
MMR.desc: CogniStar doesn't rely on pre-set static stages. The backend engine implements an offline MMR rating system (from 800 to 2500 MMR) to dynamically calculate appropriate tasks for kids.
MMR.list_item1_desc: Answering correctly in under 3 seconds awards a big MMR boost (+30 ELO), scaling the next task difficulty immediately.
MMR.list_item2_desc: If a child gets stuck at advanced stages (Level 60+), the game initiates visual scaffolding to separate colors from shapes and guide them step-by-step.
MMR.list_item3_desc: Saves child touch trace velocities (x, y, timestamp) to let them race visually against their own past ghost curveline speeds weeks later.
MMR.grade1_desc: Slower timers (60s), enlarged buttons (48px+ touch area) for motor coordination.
MMR.grade2_desc: Accelerated timers (30s limit), complex 3D perspective tasks, and logic dev gates.

Zen.title: Zen Mode & Accessibility Tab
Zen.desc: CogniStar is uniquely optimized for ADHD, Autism, or Sensory Anxiety. The Accessibility settings allow children to train their brains at their own pace without unnecessary timers, strobe animations, or loud buzzer alarms.
Zen.c1_desc: Calming palette shifts reduce eye strain and sensory spikes.
Zen.c2_desc: Focuses entirely on completion accuracy over speed metrics.

Limits.title: Level Trials & Worksheet Calendars
Limits.desc: We've introduced fair, level-based usage limits to replace rigid timed evaluations, giving children space to learn before choosing to upgrade.
Limits.c1_desc: Play the first 10 adventure stages offline without committing to memberships.
Limits.c2_desc: Premium users can output structured PDF homework worksheets once every 7 days.

Categories.title: 144 Specialized Brain Game Categories
Categories.subtitle: CogniStar procedurally renders clean SVGs for every puzzle at runtime. Here is a showcase of featured cognitive sub-games.
Categories.cat1_desc: Select correct math symbols (+, -, *, /) dynamically to balance the mathematical equation.
Categories.cat2_desc: Select polyomino block configurations that perfectly match the target geometric shape.
Categories.cat3_desc: Analyze 3x3 pattern matrices to apply logical rotations, scales, and mirror rules.
Categories.cat4_desc: Decrypt number relationships encoded in alphabetical vowel and consonant distributions.
Categories.cat5_desc: Solve algebraic equations visualized dynamically on mechanical balances.
Categories.cat6_desc: Follow intertwined circuits to map wire paths visually from inputs to correct endpoints.
Categories.cat7_desc: Calculate laser reflection trajectories using 45-degree angle positioning grids.
Categories.cat8_desc: Solve visual overlaps to predict if pulling a rope configuration will lock or slip.
